authorizations.request_source: Owner direction of 2026-09-21, relayed to this build by the release coordinator after the owner was told that imported public statistical figures and vote totals were being displayed as blank cells: "Ok well we want all the data and links etc to show". The message itself is not held in this repository. The owner gave a direction, not a field list: every field below was derived by this build from that direction by reading the loaded store column by column, and the owner has not confirmed the list field by field. Read it before relying on it, and revoke it if it says more than was meant.
authorizations.statement: The owner directs, at the owner's own risk and ahead of the independent reviews, that the public-safe factual values this project has already imported be shown to anonymous readers rather than blanked. This decision names, source by source and field by field: (1) the figures the official 2023 election results publications print - candidate and party votes, the published vote share, seat counts, list positions, the counted and informal tallies of each electorate summary, and the status that says whether a number was reported at all; (2) the donation, expense and loan totals the Electoral Commission itself prints on its own public finance index pages, and whether a linked return document is a scan; (3) the descriptive and provenance columns of the imported Parliament, election, finance and statistics sources - the publisher's own identifiers, dates as printed, file digests, routing keys, and for official statistics the qualifiers, quality measures and row locators that belong with a figure already shown. Each is shown with its publisher, its official link and a notice that reviews are pending. This decision adds field decisions only: it deploys nothing and releases no rows by itself (OWNER-AUTH-2026-09-20-01 does that, for as long as it is in force). It widens one limit OWNER-AUTH-2026-09-20-02 set, and says so: statistical qualifiers and standard errors are now shown, because a published figure without the qualifier printed beside it is the less honest of the two.
departs_from: RED-LINES R10 as written: it says no new public surface or data product goes live before a legal-review entry names a reviewer, and allows no exceptions. None exists. The owner proceeds anyway; this is a departure from R10, not compliance with it.
RED-LINES R8 as written: it says nothing goes live without a named accountable person. Nobody has accepted that role. The owner proceeds anyway; this is a departure from R8, not compliance with it.

OWNER-AUTH-2026-09-20-02 listed statistical qualifiers and standard errors as never in its scope. This decision shows them. That entry is not edited and is not withdrawn; this one is wider, and the difference is stated here rather than hidden.
RED-LINES.md itself is not amended by this decision.

Neither message is kept here: the text of each is not held in this repository. This entry extends that to the parts the first entry missed: (1) the allowlisted payload of each imported source, key by key - the publisher's own identifiers, names as published, dates as printed, page and file digests, status words and this project's own capture and completeness notes; (2) the disclosed finance facts that were captured and left unread - the donation, expense and loan totals the Electoral Commission itself prints on its own public index pages, the filing dates it states, whether it says an audit report was required, the party and candidate names as published, and the links to the original return documents; (3) the party-vote percentages each pollster published, with the sample size where one was disclosed, the pollster's own account of how the poll was run, and this project's record of whether a methodology disclosure was found. scopes.basis: The upstream identifiers and status words the capture carries for each candidacy row: the nomination and party-selection status as the export states them, the upstream candidacy type and election reference, the upstream electorate-type label, and the two one-word records of how the figures were evidenced. Identifiers and status words, with the official link.

The candidate vote count as the payload of the verified 963-row capture of the official 2023 results holds it: the same fact the typed column already shows, released by the same decision so the record and the projection cannot disagree. No total, average, ranking or trend is derived (R1).

The electorate name and number as the official result page prints them, the publisher's own row identifiers and display order, the vote TYPE each line is ('party' or 'candidate'), the counts of result lines read, this project's record of how a line was joined to the 2023 candidacy product, and the digest and completeness flags of the captured page. Names, identifiers and counts, with the official link.

The candidate and party vote totals each official 2023 electorate result page prints, with the official link. A cell the page reported no number for is shown as its status, never as zero. No ranking, average or trend is derived from them (R1).

The party name as the official nationwide table prints it, the coverage and result scope of the table, the election year, and the digest and completeness flags of the captured page. Names and scope labels, with the official link.

The party vote percentage exactly as the official 2023 nationwide results table prints it, beside the denominator note that says what it is a percentage of. No ranking, average or trend is derived from it (R1).
The boundary edition, the kind of link and the publisher's own election reference for each of the three official 2025 boundary summary maps, with the digest of the captured page.

The election name and the availability status of the official 2026 electorate finder page, with the publisher's own election reference. An availability record; it lists no nomination and no candidate.

The candidate, party and electorate names as the Electoral Commission publishes them on its public index of filed returns, the return kind, the reporting year, the page count, the status of each published total, the link and digest of the index page, and this project's own capture and normalisation status words. Nothing is read from inside a return document.

The donation, expense and loan totals the Electoral Commission itself prints on its public 2023 candidate returns index page, and the recorded basis for reading them (the stored records state amounts_basis = commission_index_page_as_published). Nothing is read from inside a return: no donor, no postal address of a donor, no signature, no line of a return.

The party name as the Commission publishes it, the period the return covers, the links to the original return documents the Commission lists, and the digest of the captured index page. Nothing is read from inside a return document.

The list of totals the Electoral Commission itself prints on its public 2025 party finance index page, each with the amount, its status, the filing dates the Commission states and whether it says an audit report was required, and the recorded basis for reading them. Nothing is read from inside a return: no donor, no postal address of a donor, no signature, no line of a return.

The party name as the Commission publishes it, the return kind and version type, the reporting year, the page counts, how many pages were looked at, this project's own sentence about what it entered and what it did not, and the link and digest of the index page. Nothing is read from inside a return document.

The stage and status of a bill as the publisher's public catalogue states them, the Parliament number, and the publisher's own page links for the bill and for the index of its published versions. Never bill text; no file is held (R6).

The members named in charge of a bill as the publisher prints them, the publisher's own last-updated timestamp, and the count and list of recorded stages. Office-holders in their public capacity (R7). Never bill text (R6).

The document type of each item of business, the publisher's publication date and its own last-modified timestamp. NOT the item title, label or subtitle: petition items are titled with the name of the private person who petitioned (R7).

The title, committee, publication date and public page link of each report FILE as the publisher lists them, and the flag that says this row is metadata only. A link to the publisher's own file; the file and its text are never held or shown (R6).

The document type of each report and the publisher's own last-modified timestamp. NOT the report title, label or subtitle: 247 of the 1,286 reports are petition reports whose titles name the private person who petitioned (R7).
The publisher's own last-activity timestamp for a bill in its current-bills catalogue. Never bill text (R6).

The member name as the open-data file prints it, the publisher's own person reference and public page link, the stated basis of each date, and the flag that says this row is metadata only. Office-holders in their public capacity (R7); no contact detail of anyone.

The office-holder's name as the Government's own minister pages print it, the role and portfolio names, the role type at source, the publisher's own person reference and page link, and the stated basis of each date. Office-holders in their public capacity (R7).

The release title and the publisher's own item id, page link, minister and portfolio page links, its date exactly as printed and its own last-modified timestamp. Never the release text or a summary of it (R6).
The publisher date of each release, how this project collected the page, and the size and digest of the page it read. Never the release text or a summary of it (R6).

The ministerial title and role reference of the minister answering, the publisher's own attachment reference and its size, and the publisher's own last-modified timestamp. Office-holders in their public capacity (R7). Never the text of a question or a reply, and never a digest or character count of that text (R6).

The page title and party name as each registered party's own public policy page prints them, the date the publisher states, the basis recorded for that date, the count of linked documents, and the digest of the captured page. Never page text (R6). The upstream classification labels this capture carries are NOT in this decision: no model run is recorded and nobody has reviewed them (R9).

The pollster's own disclosure of how the poll was run, as the pollster published it: the commissioner, the provider, the sponsor, the mode, the stated margin of error, the links to the pollster's own index and disclosure pages, and this project's own record of how complete that disclosure was and why. Published so that a reader sees a poll figure with the pollster's own account of the poll beside it.

The party-vote percentages each pollster published, the sample size where the pollster disclosed one, and the status that says whether a figure was reported at all. Every figure is shown beside this project's own record of whether a methodology disclosure was found for that poll, which is link metadata and cannot be blank. No average, ranking or trend across polls is derived (R1).

not_claimed: No independent legal review has been carried out. Every REVIEW-REGISTER.md row stays PENDING with nobody appointed (R10).
Nobody has accepted the accountable-person role (R8). This decision does not name one.

No publisher has granted a licence or permission. Every rights-register row stays pending and link-only; none is marked approved by this decision. That a pollster published a number, or that the Electoral Commission printed a total on a public page, is not that publisher's permission to republish it.
No security sign-off exists for the evidence store.
No claim that any poll's methodology is sound. Three of the twelve polls held record that no methodology disclosure was found, and that record is shown beside every figure of those polls.
This field list was derived by reading the loaded store key by key, not dictated field by field by the owner. It is recorded as derived.
never_in_scope: donor names, donation amounts, donation dates and per-donation recipients: NOT because they are being withheld, but because this project has never collected a donation record. There is no donations table and no donor column; the loader's contract refuses any key matching donor or contributor at any depth. The only money held is the Electoral Commission's own published per-candidate and per-party totals, and those ARE shown, with the filing dates and the link to each original return
residential addresses, signatures and contact details of anyone, in any projection
anything read from INSIDE a finance return: no line, no amount, no name from a return document. approved_total is on no token list anywhere
the character counts and digests of question, reply, release and document text: the text itself is never held, and OWNER-AUTH-2026-09-20-02 recorded that its digest is not shown either
titles, labels and subtitles of select committee reports and items of business: petition titles name the private person who petitioned

the upstream classification labels of the party policy pages: no model run is recorded and nobody has reviewed them (R9). The policy class published for every one of them is 'unknown' on a recorded basis of 'none'
canonical (merged) people or parties: names stay exactly as each source printed them
any source whose rights row is refused, restricted or withheld: those stay invisible whatever this file says, figure and label together

authorizations.request_source: The owner's direction of 2026-09-21, relayed by the release coordinator: add the officially disclosed donation records to the evidence store and show meaningful donor names, recipients, published amounts, the dates the source states, reporting periods and types, statuses, and the official links. The same direction sets the boundary this entry keeps: safe disclosed donor names are permitted, and residential or street addresses, signatures, contact details, private identifiers and bank details are not. The message itself is not held in this repository.
authorizations.statement: The owner directs that the donations a party or candidate DISCLOSED inside a filed Electoral Commission return be published, where this project can read them from the return honestly. That is a new kind of record for this store: until now it held the Commission's index of filed returns and the totals printed on the Commission's own pages, and no donation at all. This entry releases, for the two return-disclosure products only (P25, the 2023 candidate returns; P26, the 2025 party annual returns): the donor name the return gives, where it could be separated from the street address printed with it in the same cell and proved not to be one; the amount of each entry and the total the form prints for each part; and the descriptive fields that make those figures readable - the recipient, the part and its label, the reporting year, the dates the return states, the amendment flag, and the official link to the return. An identity the law withholds stays withheld: an anonymous donation and a donation protected from disclosure are published with no name and with the status that says why. An entry is published only where the entries of its part sum exactly to the total the Commission's own form prints for that part; every other part is published with its printed total, the number of entries it declares and the reason no entry of it is shown. No address, no signature, no contact detail and no document text is stored anywhere in this store, and the column that holds a donor name refuses any value carrying a digit or a street word.

scopes.basis: Everything about a disclosure that is not the money or the donor: which part of the Commission's own form disclosed it, the label that part carries, the candidate, their electorate and their party as the return names them, the reporting year, the dates the return states, whether the document is an amendment, the official link and digest of the return and of the index page that lists it, how many entries the part declares, and the two status words that say how completely this project could read that part. Identifiers, labels, dates and status words, each with the official link beside it.

The donation facts the filed return itself discloses: the donor name where the return names one, the two words that say whether a name was published, withheld by law or not separable, the amount of each entry, and the total the form prints for the part it sits in. A disclosure Parliament requires to be public, shown as the return states it. Nothing is totalled, averaged, ranked or compared across returns, and no entry is shown for a part whose entries do not sum exactly to the form's own printed total.

Everything about a disclosure that is not the money or the donor: which part of the Commission's own form disclosed it, the label that part carries, the party as the return names them, the reporting year, the dates the return states, whether the document is an amendment, the official link and digest of the return and of the index page that lists it, how many entries the part declares, and the two status words that say how completely this project could read that part. Identifiers, labels, dates and status words, each with the official link beside it.

The donation facts the filed return itself discloses: the donor name where the return names one, the two words that say whether a name was published, withheld by law or not separable, the amount of each entry, and the total the form prints for the part it sits in. A disclosure Parliament requires to be public, shown as the return states it. Nothing is totalled, averaged, ranked or compared across returns, and no entry is shown for a part whose entries do not sum exactly to the form's own printed total.

never_in_scope: a donor's residential or street address, or any part of one: no such column exists in this store, and the column that holds a donor name refuses any value carrying a digit or a street word
signatures, contact details, bank or account details, dates of birth and any other private identifier printed on a return
the identity behind an anonymous donation or a donation protected from disclosure: the law withholds it and so does this store
the text of a return document, a copy of the PDF, or any page capture of one
a donor total across returns, a ranking of donors, or any comparison this project computes rather than the publisher printing it
an entry of a part whose entries do not sum exactly to the total the Commission's own form prints for that part
any source whose rights row is refused, restricted or withheld: those stay invisible whatever this file says
not_claimed: No independent legal review has been carried out (R10). Every REVIEW-REGISTER.md row stays PENDING with no reviewer named. The specific questions a reviewer would be asked are open: whether republishing a name the Electoral Commission itself publishes carries any further obligation, and what a correction or removal process should be.
Nobody has accepted the accountable-person role (R8). This decision does not name one and does not stand in for one.
No publisher has granted a licence or permission. Both rights-register rows stay pending and link-only, and a recorded refusal or restriction by the publisher would hide these sources entirely.
No claim that a donor consented to this republication, or was asked.

No claim of completeness. Most returns in this corpus could not be read: 171 of 492 candidate returns and 10 of 23 party return versions are on the Commission's form and readable, and entries are published for 33 parts of them. Every other part says so in its own row.

No claim that a figure here is audited, correct, or the same as any figure published elsewhere. Where the Commission also prints a total for the same return, the two are compared and reported, never added together or replaced by one another.
No claim about any donor's motive, influence, or relationship with a party or candidate, and no link between a donor and any decision, policy or appointment.
No merging of people or organisations by name. Two entries naming the same words are two entries; nothing here asserts they are the same donor, and no donor total across returns is computed.

The donations-over-$20,000 notices the Electoral Commission publishes separately during an election year are NOT collected at all: that page answers this host with a challenge, which this project records and does not work around. Nothing here is a substitute for them, and no row here is added to one.
